messages.author: 6fb2ca864eb56c10
messages.subject: High LOD in permutation thresholds
parts:
Hello Karl,

What could cause elevated LOD thresholds in the range 3.8-4 instead of the usual 2.9-3.3 for a quantitative trait using "hk" as the method?

Thanks,
Konstantin

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] High LOD in permutation thresholds
parts:
Maybe outliers in the phenotypes?

I'd first look at the distribution of the permutation results; is there a second mode with really high LOD scores, or is the whole distribution stretched out?

karl
